identity: Grounded heroic fantasy; a declining world that remains beautiful and hopeful.

authoring.wear: Local physical wear; no blanket noise or arbitrary emissive polish.

lighting.outdoor_gi: Sky radiance; no streaming voxel-GI rebuilds
lighting.indoor_gi: Bounded ambient and practical lights; authored lightmaps may be used for static interiors
lighting.exposure: Authored bounded multipliers, no automatic exposure pumping

weather.shelter: Camera roof ray plus explicit EnvironmentVolume and heightfield particle collision

decals.placement: Authored locally at physical causes; never blanket coverage

vfx.magic: SpellSchools.Color remains canonical; no ordinary-world magical glow. Spell effects are the stated exception: a cast, its travel, its impact and what it leaves behind may glow, with hue from SpellSchools.Color through VfxPalette

spell_effects.authority: SpellVfx facade, SpellVfxDirector and VfxBudgetRules; quality from Settings.SpellEffects (-1 follows the preset)
spell_effects.emission_energy: Core 4 to 8 so effects bloom past the 1.2 glow threshold; must read hot with glow off
spell_effects.lifetime: Children of the session VfxRoot, never of an actor; cleared when a load begins

vfx.fire: Authored flames and warm practical light; EnvironmentEmitters applies shared wind, distance and quality budgets

performance.status: Targets; verify on each supported device. Component costs require GPU profiler attribution.

asset_policy: Source model, rig, animation and Blender/Meshy pipelines remain untouched.
